# QS-PROC-08 Ring rolling dimensional control (P2)
Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Scope
- This quality specification defines dimensional control requirements for ring rolling operations on line P2-L2 and associated heat treat staging at EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Applies to all ring rolling billets and forgings processed on P2-L2 that will be heat treated using EQ-P2-L2-HT02 and subsequently inspected for dimensional conformance.
- Excludes operations outside of P2-L2 and heat treat furnaces not identified as EQ-P2-L2-HT02.
- Cross-reference change notices and procedural instructions are provided in ECN-2026-028, ECN-2026-031, and SOP-P2-L2-04.

Background and rationale
- Dimensional drift during ring rolling and handling to heat treat can cause downstream nonconformance that impacts machining yield and final assembly acceptance. This specification consolidates inspection points, acceptance rationale, and corrective actions to protect product geometry and traceability.
- The lubricant specified for furnace staging and contact surfaces for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is CFW-LUB-376. Using the specified lubricant mitigates surface upset and localized galling during handling between rolling and heat treat staging; lubricant selection is controlled to maintain metallurgical and dimensional integrity per ECN-2026-028 and SOP-P2-L2-04.

Requirements table

| Requirement ID | Description | Acceptance criteria |
|---|---|---|
| R-A | Dimensional inspection at final roll exit | Measured geometry shall match drawing intent and specified tolerances documented in customer drawing or job traveler; measurement plan shall reference the drawing noted on the traveler |
| R-B | Inspection immediately prior to heat treat staging at EQ-P2-L2-HT02 | Parts shall be assessed for handling damage, burrs, and witness marks; parts with handling damage that could affect final machining are segregated |
| R-C | Lubricant control for staging and contact surfaces | Only lubricant CFW-LUB-376 is authorized for use on surfaces that contact parts staged for EQ-P2-L2-HT02 |
| R-D | Measurement instrument calibration and traceability | Instruments used for dimensional checks shall be listed on the job traveler; calibration status shall be available in records; measurements without instrument status are not accepted |
| R-E | Record retention and traceability | Dimensional reports, traveler sign-off, and lubricant lot used shall be retained with the job file in accordance with shop quality retention rules defined in ECN-2026-031 |

Inspection method
- Sampling and measurement plan:
  - Inspection locations and measurement features shall be derived from the customer drawing referenced on the job traveler. Inspectors shall follow the sequence in SOP-P2-L2-04 for handling and measurement to minimize handling-induced variation.
  - Measurement devices shall be confirmed as calibrated and suitable for the feature type. Record device identifier and calibration status on the dimensional report.
- Measurement procedure overview:
  - Clean the feature per SOP-P2-L2-04 and remove transient debris using approved wipes and, where staging contact is required, use only CFW-LUB-376 as the contact lubricant. Document lubricant lot in the dimensional report.
  - Orient the part using datum features specified on the drawing. Apply measurement devices according to instrument manufacturer guidance and good metrology practice. Record each reading and the instrument identifier.
  - For features with tight form or concentricity intent, perform comparative checks against the master fixture or reference standard recorded in the job file.
- Examples and clarifications:
  - Example scenario: a ring leaving the final roll shows a surface nick at a noncritical location. Inspector segregates part per R-B and records the condition; part disposition follows Nonconformance handling below.
  - Example scenario: a measurement device is found with expired calibration status. Measurements made with that device are invalid. Re-measure the part with a calibrated device and note the corrective action on the dimensional report.
- Records to keep:
  - Dimensional report for each work order with part identifier, feature measurements, instrument identifiers, lubricant lot used (CFW-LUB-376), inspector initials or electronic signature, and reference drawing noted.
  - Job traveler sign-off showing inspection points completed.
  - Instrument calibration certificates or traceable identifiers supporting the measurement devices used.
  - Segregation tags and disposition records for any parts placed on hold.

Nonconformance handling
- Immediate actions:
  - Any part failing to meet the drawing intent or showing handling damage that could affect downstream processing shall be segregated and tagged with a hold status. The hold tag shall reference the part identifier and the reason for hold.
  - Notify the shift quality lead and the rolling supervisor. Reference ECN-2026-028 for engineering notification requirements when part geometry deviates from baseline expectations.
- Investigation and disposition:
  - Perform root cause assessment focusing on process steps from final roll through staging at EQ-P2-L2-HT02, including handling, fixturing, and lubricant application. Include review of the dimensional report, instrument calibration records, and the lubricant lot recorded for CFW-LUB-376 usage.
  - Disposition options include rework, repair, use-as-is with concession, or scrap, as permitted by customer agreements and internal engineering authorization. Document disposition decision and responsible approver in the job file.
- Corrective actions and preventive measures:
  - For repeated incidents tied to handling or fixturing, implement containment and process changes; update SOP-P2-L2-04 when changes to handling or measurement sequences are required.
  - When lubricant-related issues are suspected, verify lubricant lot and shelf condition for CFW-LUB-376 and suspend use pending investigation. Record findings and corrective actions in the nonconformance record.
- Records and closure:
  - All nonconformance records, investigation notes, disposition approvals, and verification results are retained with the job file and cross-referenced to ECN-2026-031 where change documentation is required.
  - Closure of nonconformance requires verification that corrective actions are implemented and that affected lots are either reworked to meet drawing intent or properly disposed.

Related documents
- ECN-2026-028
- ECN-2026-031
- SOP-P2-L2-04

Revision control and approvals
- Maintain this specification under document control. Approval block and revision history are stored in the document control system with links to the job files and related ECN records.
